summary: The school district urges the FCC to preserve and strengthen the E-Rate program, rejecting proposals to sunset or eliminate it, and emphasizes the importance of reliable broadband for modern education.

claims.argument: The program has been crucial for Barrington CUSD 220 to provide reliable broadband to students and maintain educational infrastructure
claims.evidence_quote: Barrington CUSD 220 has received $712,052 in committed federal E-Rate support over funding years 2021–2025 — an average of roughly $142,410 a year toward the connections our students depend on.
